key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04F6
name: wait_for_ram_flag_clear
description: Loops, re-reading one byte of game RAM, until that byte's sign bit is clear, then returns. It is a plain polling wait on a flag that another routine is expected to change.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:14:04FC
name: invoke_and_clear_table_entries
description: Walks 50 eight-byte entries in the data block. For each entry whose first longword is non-zero, it calls a routine through a stored code pointer and then zeroes that entry's two longwords.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:0126
name: clear_and_store_word_fields
description: Clears one 16-bit field in the state block and writes the incoming 16-bit argument into a neighbouring field. It does nothing else.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:0136
name: copy_slot_and_invoke_helper
description: Copies a 32-bit state field into a second slot, then calls a routine with that slot's address, a position built from an indexed table word plus a stored offset, and a stored 32-bit value.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:0188
name: set_flag_on_escape_key
description: Calls a routine that returns a 16-bit code and passes that code back unchanged. When the code is 27, the Escape character, it also sets a 16-bit flag in the state block to 1.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:01A2
name: poll_flags_and_check_entry
description: Returns a status byte. If neither of two flag bytes in the state is set, it reads a value and, when that value is non-zero, tests one bit of a per-index table and runs two follow-up calls if the bit is set. If either flag is set, it waits in a loop until both are clear and returns a different status.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:0212
name: interpret_byte_script_stream
description: Reads bytes from a buffer through a cursor and dispatches on each one: values below 128 become the current value, while codes 128 to 139 handle loop counters, cursor resets, channel switches, modulo-based values and calls to other routines. The loop ends on its stop codes, after calling a routine for each non-negative current value.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:0408
name: add_record_word10_to_result
description: Calls a routine that returns a 16-bit value and adds the word at offset 10 of the structure passed in, returning the sum.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:0422
name: add_record_word12_to_result
description: Calls a routine that returns a 16-bit value and adds the word at offset 12 of the structure passed in, returning the sum.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:043C
name: initialize_entry_table_from_bounds
description: Fills a table of entries from a count argument. For each entry it draws values from a called routine to place it between the bounds stored in a structure, sets a value from 0 to 29 and a size of 2 or 3, then writes two fixed starting words.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:0502
name: update_entry_table_per_frame
description: Advances each table entry by a shared step and re-initialises any entry that has moved past its bound, using new values from a called routine. It then passes the table and two fixed values through draw calls and advances a counter that wraps back to zero at 320.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:0650
name: initialize_counter_and_parameters
description: Stores the input count minus one as a limit, resets a running index to zero, and saves a 16-bit parameter and a 32-bit pointer into the state block for later use.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:0674
name: add_and_update_timed_entries
description: Adds a new entry when a called routine's result passes a modulo test and the count is below its limit, giving it a size from 4 to 7 and a position inside a range taken from a structure. It then steps each entry's counter down, re-initialises entries whose counter has reached zero, and passes every entry to a draw call.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:087A
name: copy_state_and_update_index
description: Copies a block of 12 longwords from global state onto the stack, then uses an index read from a returned structure to look up and store back a value in that stack copy. It makes one of two calls depending on whether the value is below 10, followed by three more calls.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:0980
name: run_intro_sequence_scenes
description: Runs the intro sequence by copying several state blocks, then running timed loops of 50 and 30 frame steps that exit early when a stop flag is set. It references the intro text files intro_1, intro_1a, intro_1b, intro_2, intro_2a and intro_3 through a large number of called routines.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1DBA
name: copy_value_to_four_fields
description: Calls a routine, then copies one 32-bit state value into four other 32-bit state fields so they all start with the same value.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1DD8
name: divide_with_quotient_and_remainder
description: Calls a routine for a 16-bit value and divides it by a 16-bit divisor, returning the quotient in the upper half and the remainder in the lower half of a 32-bit result.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1DEC
name: descend_into_block_entry
description: Looks up a sub-entry by index in a table of offsets, skips past the sub-block data using a bit mask, and calls a routine with the entry's position relative to the caller's offsets, its size, its mask and an incremented level value. It does nothing when the index is out of range.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1DF2
name: toggle_and_fetch_table_entry
description: Reads a 32-bit entry from a two-slot table at the current index and stores it in the caller's output and a state field. It then flips the index bit, copies the entry for the new index to the same outputs, and calls two routines.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1DF8
name: forward_single_helper_call
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns, with no other work. It only forwards the call.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1DFE
name: or_merge_five_plane_blocks
description: Combines five plane blocks of 2000 longwords each by bitwise OR, one longword at a time, and writes each result into a separate destination block.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E04
name: return_empty_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E0A
name: sum_state_word_and_byte
description: Calls routines and returns their combined value plus a state word and a byte passed on the stack. It also stores the total through an optional pointer when that pointer is non-null.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E10
name: composite_masked_rows_into_planes
description: Copies a 40-byte-wide, 200-row area across five planes of screen memory. Where the mask byte is not fully set it clears the mask's set bits in the destination and merges in the source bits, and where the mask is fully set it copies the source across.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E16
name: return_zero_if_null_pointer
description: Returns zero when its pointer argument is null. Otherwise it calls two routines before returning.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E1C
name: call_routine_with_record_span
description: Calls a routine with the longword at the start of a structure, the word at byte offset 12, and a length equal to the word at byte offset 14 minus the word at offset 12, plus one.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E22
name: switch_state_word_with_calls
description: Changes a 16-bit state word only when the requested value differs from the stored one. If a state longword is set, it calls routines for the old value and then for the new value, one of them with the constant 50000, and stores the new value last.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E28
name: test_adjacent_state_bytes_differ
description: Returns whether the byte at one state offset differs from the byte at the next offset. It is a plain inequality test on two flag bytes.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E2E
name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns. It only forwards control.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E34
name: copy_state_and_call_pair
description: Copies one 32-bit state value into two other state longwords, then calls a routine with one of them, a word and a longword from state, and calls another routine with a second state field and the copied value.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E3A
name: reset_state_and_read_result
description: Clears three state longwords, then calls a routine for a value and, when that value is non-negative, stores it and calls two further routines. It returns a 32-bit result whose low word is a state word, with a zero value replaced by the maximum unsigned 16-bit value.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E40
name: set_flags_from_mode_word
description: Copies two global words into state slots. It then sets one flag byte to 1 when the mode word is 1, and a second flag byte to 2 when the mode word is 2, otherwise to 0.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E46
name: return_empty_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E4C
name: return_empty_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E52
name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Makes two calls to other routines in sequence and returns. It does no other work.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E58
name: configure_state_by_case_index
description: Copies five state longwords onto the stack and loops calling a routine while it returns non-zero, then copies four state longwords into a second block. It then runs a chain of cases on the argument, each case setting its own group of state words and calling routines with fixed addresses.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E5E
name: forward_two_routine_calls
description: Makes two calls to other routines and returns. It does no other work.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E64
name: return_routine_result_if_set
description: Returns zero when a state longword is zero. Otherwise it returns the result of a called routine.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E6A
name: return_empty_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E70
name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Makes two calls to other routines in sequence and returns. It does no other work.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E76
name: call_with_smaller_record_span
description: Stores the word at offset 10 of each of two records into global words, then calls a routine with the first record's longword and offset-12 word, the smaller of the two spans (each span is the word at offset 14 minus the word at offset 12, plus one), and the second record's longword and offset-12 word.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E7C
name: advance_seed_return_high_bits
description: Calls a routine for a value, adds 12345 to it, and stores the sum in a state longword. It returns the upper 15 bits of that sum.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E82
name: return_empty_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E88
name: read_cycling_table_word
description: Waits by calling a routine until it returns non-zero, then returns the word at the current position of a 100-entry table and advances that position, wrapping back to zero after the last entry.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E8E
name: return_empty_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E94
name: copy_pair_to_pointer_list
description: Copies the two longwords at the argument into each destination pointer in a zero-terminated list of pointers passed on the stack, then returns zero.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:2:1E9A
name: composite_masked_longwords_into_planes
description: Composites 2000 longwords across five planes of screen memory, one longword at a time. Where the mask longword is not fully set it clears the mask's set bits in each destination plane and merges in the source bits, and where the mask is fully set it copies the source straight across.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:0000
name: process_input_event_record
description: Processes one input event record. For one event type it adds the record's two deltas to clamped screen coordinates and sets or clears flag bits for two particular codes, and for another type it updates flag bits and two globals; either way it then marks the event as handled.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:0042
name: update_pointer_and_key_flags
description: Stores a register value as the first coordinate, clamped at zero, and adds a delta to the second coordinate, clamped to the range 0 to 199. It then sets or clears flag bits from two key codes and marks the event as handled.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:0050
name: update_y_and_key_flags
description: Adds a delta to the second coordinate, clamped to the range 0 to 199, stores a register value as the first coordinate, and updates flag bits from two key codes before marking the event as handled.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:0072
name: clamp_y_and_update_flags
description: Stores a register value as the second coordinate, clamped at zero, updates flag bits from two key codes, and marks the event as handled.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:007E
name: store_y_and_update_flags
description: Stores a register value as the second coordinate, updates flag bits from two key codes, and marks the event as handled.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:00D2
name: handle_flagged_key_event
description: For events of one type, sets or clears a flag byte from two bits of the event word and sets a global value when a particular key code appears. It then calls two routines and marks the event as handled.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:00DE
name: update_key_event_flags
description: Sets or clears a flag byte from two bits of the event word and sets a global value when a particular key code appears. It then calls two routines and marks the event as handled, without a type check.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:0158
name: open_input_device_for_requests
description: Builds an input request block in state, opens the input device by name using that block, and then issues an I/O request through the device. The returned request and result are kept in state.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:01D4
name: send_input_device_request
description: Writes the command value 10 into a request block, points the request's data at a buffer in state, and sends the request through a device I/O call.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:01F8
name: translate_key_code_with_flags
description: Strips the release bit from the key code, then looks up a value for codes below 96 in one of several per-key tables, selected by flag words in state. Codes 96 to 103 instead record a state flag and return zero.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:0268
name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero without doing anything else.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:026E
name: lookup_key_table_entry
description: Returns zero when the first argument is zero. Otherwise it returns a value from one of several per-key tables selected by state flags, subtracting 32 when a table flag pattern applies.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:027A
name: lookup_table_entry_by_index
description: Returns a value from one of several per-key tables selected by state flags, subtracting 32 when a table flag pattern and a state flag both apply.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:0292
name: lookup_key_entry_with_modifiers
description: Returns a value from one of three per-key table columns, chosen by state flag words. It subtracts 32 when a table flag pattern and a state flag both apply.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:02B0
name: lookup_key_entry_two_columns
description: Returns a value from one of two per-key table columns, chosen by two state flag words. It subtracts 32 when a table flag pattern and a state flag both apply.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:02CE
name: lookup_key_entry_fixed_column
description: Returns a value from one fixed per-key table column, subtracting 32 when a table flag pattern and a state flag both apply.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:0306
name: return_empty_stub
description: Does nothing and returns immediately.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:0314
name: process_linked_record_list
description: Walks a linked list of records starting from a state address until a null link. For each record whose flags have one bit clear and another set, and whose two words differ, it calls a routine, and it calls one more routine at the end.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:031A
name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Makes one call to another routine and returns. It only forwards control.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:0320
name: create_record_with_argument
description: Returns zero for a null argument. Otherwise it calls a routine that returns a record pointer and, when that pointer is non-zero, sets the record's byte at offset 8 to 5, its byte at offset 9 to zero, and stores the argument at offset 14.

key: ultima vi - the false prophet (1992)(mindscape)[cr panther][a](disk 1 of 4)(program)/Ultima VI - The False Prophet (1992)(Mindscape)[cr Panther][a](Disk 1 of 4)(Program).adf:u:18:0326
name: reset_record_fields
description: Calls a routine on the record's offset-10 value when that value is set. It then sets the record's byte at offset 8 to 255 and its longword at offset 20 to -1, and calls two routines.
